rows.label: bf06140130_0010
rows.name: Now then... the ship to Luxuria is

rows.label: bf06140130_0020
rows.name: The Pope should have a ship ready for us.

rows.label: bf06140130_0030
rows.name: Hey, Turtle-chan.

rows.label: bf06140130_0040
rows.name: What?

rows.label: bf06140130_0050
rows.name:
Are we really okay leaving
Meleph and the others behind?

rows.label: bf06140130_0060
rows.name:
It's not about leaving them behind. Their position
and purpose were different from ours to begin with.

rows.label: bf06140130_0070
rows.name: Yeah, but still...

rows.label: bf06140130_0080
rows.name:
Anyway, her schedule is filled
with official duties right now.

rows.label: bf06140130_0090
rows.name:
For sure. It's just a
bit of a shame, is all.

rows.label: bf06140130_0100
rows.name:
You know, since we came
all this way together.

rows.label: bf06140130_0110
rows.name: Well, I understand how you feel

rows.label: bf06140130_0120
rows.name: Uh? Speak of the devil...

rows.label: bf06140130_0130
rows.name: Bahn's going for the summit?

rows.label: bf06140130_0140
rows.name: An assassination? That's hardly a small matter.

rows.label: bf06140130_0150
rows.name:
If blood gets spilled at the
summit, it'll mean war.

rows.label: bf06140130_0160
rows.name: War's good for business, after all.

rows.label: bf06140130_0170
rows.name:
So he plans to use that to make his comeback
at the Trading Company, huh?

rows.label: bf06140130_0180
rows.name:
I was wondering where he'd disappeared to.
So this is what he's been plotting.

rows.label: bf06140130_0190
rows.name: As Acting Chairman, Nilny...

rows.label: bf06140130_0200
rows.name:
wants this handled in secret, since it involves
the Trading Company.

rows.label: bf06140130_0210
rows.name: So you came to us?

rows.label: bf06140130_0220
rows.name:
If we mobilize the army, the
whole thing will become public.

rows.label: bf06140130_0230
rows.name:
Oh, I get it. So we're a
more convenient solution.

rows.label: bf06140130_0240
rows.name: I'm not forcing you.

rows.label: bf06140130_0250
rows.name:
In that case, Kagutsuchi and I
will handle it ourselves.

rows.label: bf06140130_0260
rows.name: Don't be such a stranger.

rows.label: bf06140130_0270
rows.name:
If you came all this way to ask us,
you must think it'll be tough, right?

rows.label: bf06140130_0280
rows.name: Well... yeah.

rows.label: bf06140130_0290
rows.name:
Knowing Bahn, I doubt he'd stop
at assassinating one dignitary.

rows.label: bf06140130_0300
rows.name: According to Acting Chairman Nilny...

rows.label: bf06140130_0310
rows.name:
several giant weapons were being built
at the factory where we last saw him.

rows.label: bf06140130_0320
rows.name:
And one of them is
currently unaccounted for.

rows.label: bf06140130_0330
rows.name: Giant...weapons...

rows.label: bf06140130_0340
rows.name: Got it.

rows.label: bf06140130_0350
rows.name:
We've got a long history with the chairman...
no, former chairman, too.

rows.label: bf06140130_0360
rows.name: Thank you.

rows.label: bf06140130_0370
rows.name:
Now I can focus on guarding His Majesty.
I'm counting on you.

rows.label: bf06140130_0380
rows.name: Leave it to us!
